mods.title: FNF: Animania! V-Slice Port
mods.description: Friday Night Funkin': Animania! V-Slice Port Is HereAll Credits to Animania!Crew (already written in the credits section of the port)This is a port that replicates the FNF: Animania! mod 100% (or nearly so). I am not posting this to make a profit or to claim credit for myself; all credits are already listed.What's insideSongs and weeks: Week 1 (Bopeebo, Fresh, Dad Battle), Week 5 (Cocoa, Eggnog, Winter Horrorland) and the Komi "Phone Call" level, each with its own stages, characters and note styles.Recreated menus: title screen with its intro, main menu (with the OST button that opens Animania Crew's music links), Freeplay, Story Menu, loading screen with an audio visualizer, and pause menu. All were visually recreated and then manually coded. The rest of the menus are still being worked on.Pause menu with built-in options: change your keybinds, miss/hit sound volume, framerate, judgements, note splashes, camera shake, hints, flashing lights, auto pause and vsync without leaving the song.Winter Horrorland mechanic: fully working, with its own dodge/attack system, cinematic camera and a special game over.Animania HUD: curved health bar, time bar, score, rating/combo popups, Full Combo animation and custom icons with death animations.Story Mode continuity: your health and camera position carry over between songs of the same week, so transitions feel seamless.Solo Time: the special notes and splash included.Discord Rich Presence (PC) showing the menu or the song you're playing.Mobile and performance(Mobile only) A location selector for the Winter Horrorland mechanic button: left, center or right. You can find it in Options > Preferences.Performance options in Options > Preferences: turn off the custom shaders or enable "low quality" mode if your phone or tablet isn't very powerful.Compatible with the "Mobile Like PC" mod, so many of its options and settings will work (though you should avoid using "middlescroll" during songs that move the notes, unless that doesn't bother you).If you encounter any errors, you can reach out to me on TikTok or report the bug or issue here.The news menu is coming soon...

mods.title: FNF: SONIC JAM!
mods.description: Welcome to SONIC JAMJAMMIN' NEW WEEKTake on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Revisit a classic locale, experience dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes, and rhyme at super-sonic speeds! Can you keep up?PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGNDr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. With 10+ remixes lovingly created from the ground up, you can check out a fresh, distinct take on Friday Night Funkin's music inspired by New Jack Swing, RNB, 90's House, Rock, Hip Hop, Chiptune, and many more. Face off against the worst of the worst, bring Metal Sonic's reign to an end, and free the spirit of music in Sonic's campaign.GO FOR PERFECTWhen you're playing as Sonic, simply hitting all the notes won't be enough for those brag-worthy P ranks. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!
